use: A well-maintained Roman two-wheeled relief supply cart with thick wooden spoked wheels, iron tyre rims and a low oak plank cargo bed. Four tied cream grain sacks stacked neatly with one small wicker basket. Short wooden towing shafts, no animal or driver. Warm honey weathered timber, ochre linen, sturdy practical construction, no modern features or ground slab.
